subject: Proposal: SKUs & discount path for Observability (retention + tracing + dashboards)
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Nimbus observability ask — bundling options

Hi team,

Quick summary from yesterday's call with Nimbus: they want a predictable price for observability add-ons as they scale — specifically: 90-day, 1-year retention tiers for traces, a cold-tier for raw spans, and a higher-priced advanced dashboards SKU (visuals + custom queries). They asked whether we can:

- Flatten our current per-GB + per-span model to a small set of SKUs for procurement (1/3/12 month buckets)
- Offer a committed spend discount that applies across both tracing ingestion and dashboards seats
- Provide an easy migration/proration plan for their existing retention usage (they already have ~2 TB-month/month of trace retention on our hosted API)

They also flagged procurement timelines — PO needed by 2027-05-10 to hit their quarter.

I sketched a conservative path below. Can you two help turn this into numbers we can present? Attachments: I'll include the raw notes and the current pricing matrix for reference.

Goals for the customer: keep unit economics predictable for them, preserve margin for Redwood, and avoid quote complexity for procurement.

Thanks,
Naomi

--
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0134
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Nimbus observability ask — bundling options

Naomi — good notes. Draft pricing proposal follows (high level):

Option A (Committed):
- Observability Core SKU (tracing ingestion + storage): $7,000/month per TB-month committed (12 month) — includes 30-day retention by default; extra retention tiers billed as multiplier.
- Retention Add-on: 90-day = 1.7x storage unit, 1-year = 4.8x storage unit (applied to committed TBs).
- Advanced Dashboards SKU: $1,200/license/month (up to 10 editors), $150/viewer/month. 20% discount if bundled with 12-month committed Core SKU.

Option B (Flex/Short commitment):
- Observability Core flex rate: $9,500/month per TB-month (monthly commit)
- Dashboards: same list price; no bundle discount.

Concessions we can consider (to get to PO by 05/10):
1) One-time migration credit equal to 2 months of current billed ingestion for Nimbus (they reported ~2 TB-month) — effectively a ~$19k credit if they take 12-month commit.
2) Laddered discount based on committed TBs: 5% @ 5 TB, 10% @ 10 TB, 15% @ 25 TB.
3) Waive initial onboarding fee if they sign before 2027-05-10.

I attached a quick pricing matrix (observability_pricing_matrix.xlsx) with these numbers and scenarios. If Marissa can run margin impact and Jordan can confirm SLA implications (tracing retrieval & retention SLOs), we can present to Nimbus this afternoon and include a redlined SOW.

Ben

--
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Strategic
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T13:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Nimbus observability ask — bundling options

Thanks — I ran quick margin sims. Notes:

- The retention multipliers Ben listed look roughly right for our cost model if we assume cold-tier storage on current infra. 90-day at 1.7x and 1-year at 4.8x are within margin targets for 12-month commit.
- Advanced Dashboards: licensing as per-seat with a 20% bundle looks fine; suggest we cap the 'editor' discount to the first 25 seats to protect upside.
- Migration credit: propose we express it as a one-time credit equal to 1.5 months of current bill (conservative vs Ben's 2 months) so we don't open a bigger concession.
- For proration: offer a rolling credit applied across first billing cycle post-signing; include a clause that future overages beyond committed TBs are billed at 1.25x flex rate.

I'll attach Redwood_Discussion_Notes_20270502.txt with the precise margin numbers and suggested contract language for the SOW. If we present Option A (12-month commit with laddered discount) I think we stay within red lines.

Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Director, Commercial Strategy
Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Kline <sarah.kline@nimbuscorp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, procurement@nimbuscorp.com
Date: 2027-05-03T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood proposal for Nimbus — observability SKUs and early-concession path

Sarah / Nimbus team —

Thanks for the productive conversation yesterday. Attached is our proposed package (high level) for your procurement review:

- 12-month Committed Observability Core: 10 TB-month committed at $7,000/TB-month (list), with a 10% ladder discount applied at 10 TB -> effective $6,300/TB-month. Includes 30-day standard retention.
- Retention Tier (applied to committed TBs): 90-day multiplier x1.7, 1-year multiplier x4.8. For Nimbus we modeled 10 TB * 90-day (approx) = additional $? (see attached sheet).
- Advanced Dashboards: 15 editor seats + 50 viewers. Bundle discount 15% applied to dashboards when combined with 12-month Core commit.
- Migration credit: one-time credit equal to 1.5 months of their current ingestion spend (applied on first invoice).
- Onboarding fee waived if PO signed by 2027-05-10.

Next steps we propose:
1) Procurement: confirm PO path and key contacts (procurement@nimbuscorp.com looped).
2) Legal: we will include explicit retention SLAs and an overage rate table in the SOW.
3) Finance: draft initial invoice incorporating migration credit.

Can you confirm whether the laddered discount + migration credit gets you to internal approval? If so, we will circulate a redlined SOW and a DocuSign link for signature.

Best,
Naomi

--
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Sarah Kline <sarah.kline@nimbuscorp.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@nimbuscorp.com, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-04T16:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood proposal for Nimbus — observability SKUs and early-concession path

Naomi / team — thanks for the quick turnaround and the concrete numbers. Procurement reviewed internally and here's what we can commit to now:

- We can agree to a 12-month commitment but need the committed TBs to be 8 TB (not 10) at the proposed effective $6,300/TB-month. Our finance team will prefer the lower commit to avoid capacity risk.
- For dashboards: we accept 15 editors + 50 viewers; request that the 15% bundle discount apply to all dashboard seats (no cap on editors).
- Migration credit: 1.5 months is acceptable BUT we need it explicitly called out as a credit line item in the SOW and invoice.
- We need a clause that allows one-time renegotiation at the 6-month mark if our real ingestion materially diverges (>25%).

If Redwood can accommodate the 8 TB commit + full dashboard discount + the 6-month repricing clause, we'll route a PO by 2027-05-10. Otherwise we may have to push to month-to-month.

Please confirm and send the redlined SOW.

Regards,
Sarah Kline
Head of Observability & Platform
NimbusCorp
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Kline <sarah.kline@nimbuscorp.com>, procurement@nimbuscorp.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-04T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood proposal for Nimbus — observability SKUs and early-concession path

Sarah — appreciate the clarity and quick decision. We can accommodate these asks with two small changes we need to note:

1) 8 TB commit at $6,300/TB-month accepted.
2) Full 15% dashboards discount applied to all seats for the 12-month term — accepted.
3) 6-month review clause: we will include a structured renegotiation trigger (if ingestion deviates >25%, both parties will review and agree on either one-time true-up or amendment). We will avoid unilateral repricing.
4) Migration credit and the waiver of onboarding fee will be line items in the SOW/invoice.

I'll ask Legal & Finance to push a redlined SOW and a DocuSign link by EOD so you have the PO pathway. Ben — please queue the SOW with the agreed numbers and Marissa please confirm final margin and the revenue recognition note for Finance. Jordan, I'll need you to confirm that the retention SLAs in the SOW match our product deliverables for 90-day and 1-year tiers (esp retrieval latency).

Naomi

--
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
